notes: Nebraska minimum wage applies to employers of 4+ employees (DOL table).
Nebraska meal rule covers assembly plants, workshops and mechanical establishments only, not retail (DOL table).
No state paid rest-period requirement in the DOL table; federal law does not require one.
No state daily overtime listed in the DOL table.
Drafted from US DOL WHD state tables (confidence=medium) on 2026-11-06; upgrade to primary sources pending.
minimum_wage.effective is the DOL table date (2026-11-05), not the statutory effective date.
Minors (Neb. Rev. Stat. § 48-310): Nebraska's under-16 limits (8 h/48 h, 6 a.m.-10 p.m.) are looser than federal; federal.json still applies. No Nebraska hour limits for 16-17 in § 48-310.

rules.summary: Nebraska's basic minimum wage is $15.00 an hour (DOL table, Nov. 2026).

rules.summary: Children 14-15 may work at most 8 hours a day and 48 a week, 6 a.m.-10 p.m. (later only before a non-school day with a Department of Labor special permit).

citation.title: Neb. Rev. Stat. § 48-310 — Children under sixteen; working hours
citation.excerpt: No person under sixteen years of age shall be employed ... more than forty-eight hours in any one week, nor more than eight hours in any one day, nor before the hour of 6 in the morning
